class.name: NetwWatchBook
class.brief_description: The dirty-poll engine behind every on-change retained stream.
class.description: Values in, per-recipient masks out, and nothing about nodes. A retained field replicates only when it changes, so [method poll] remembers what it last saw, and [method mask_for] heals a peer that just gained the stream with the whole row rather than with what moved since a baseline it never had: an absent baseline reads as zero, so every stamp is newer than it and the first mask is the full row for free. Stamps are a monotonic counter rather than a tick, because what a peer is owed is everything that changed since [method commit] last ran for it, and no clock answers that. The counter advances per changed field, never per poll, so two fields changing in one poll are still ordered against a baseline taken between them. Streams are keyed by an integer the caller owns rather than by this object, so a caller can drop its own key without this book outliving it. The book reads no node, which is what lets one implementation serve every front door that replicates on change.

method.name: clear
method.description: Drops every stream: its stamps and every peer's baselines.

method.name: clear_baselines
method.description: Drops [param key]'s baselines while keeping its polled row, the session-restart counterpart of [method reset].

method.name: clear_peer
method.description: Drops [param peer]'s baseline from every stream.

method.name: commit
method.description: Advances [param peer]'s baseline on [param key]'s stream to the stream's change counter, once per recipient per poll.

method.name: is_inited
method.description: Whether [param key] has ever been polled.

method.name: mask_for
method.description: What [param peer] is owed of [param key]: [code][mask, values][/code], the mask over the stream's field order of every field stamped newer than that peer's baseline, and those fields' values in set-bit order. A stream never polled owes nothing.

method.name: poll
method.description: Stamps every field of [param key] that changed since the previous poll. [param readable] is parallel to [param values], and a field marked unreadable keeps its previous stamp, so a target that is momentarily unresolvable never reads as a change. An empty [param readable] treats every field as readable. The first poll seeds the row, stamping every readable field so the first recipient heals fully. A stored value must not alias a container the caller keeps mutating, or the poll compares a value against itself forever and the field never changes again.

method.name: reset
method.description: Drops [param key]'s stamps and every baseline, so the next [method poll] reseeds and the next [method mask_for] heals every recipient with the whole new row.

method.name: retain_baselines
method.description: Drops [param key]'s baselines against any peer not in [param recipients], because a baseline outliving a peer's visibility would suppress the full-row heal it is owed on re-admission.

constants.constant: The ceiling on watched fields a stream can carry, one bit each of the mask [method mask_for] answers. A caller asserts its field count against this before polling.
